channel.description: Latest articles from The New Arab (newarab.com)

item.title: Can Lebanon Survive the Digital War?
item.description: From surveillance tech to online disinformation, responding to Israel’s digital assault on Lebanon is essential, writes Mohamad Najem.

item.title: North Korea head uses US ’aggression’ to justify nuclear arsenal
item.description: North Korea has been a fierce critic of US and Israeli aggression in the region, with its leader Kim Jong Un now speaking against the Iran war.

item.title: Asia faces energy shock as Hormuz closure disrupts oil, gas flow
item.description: Asia faces fuel shortages and rising costs as the Hormuz closure disrupts vital oil and gas supplies.

item.title: Israel prepares to mobilise 400,000 reservists in Lebanon war
item.description: Israel prepares to mobilise 400,000 reservists as it escalates its war on Lebanon, with deadly strikes intensifying despite limited ground advances

item.title: Why is Pakistan being touted as mediator between US and Iran?
item.description: Pakistan is pushing itself as mediator between Iran and the US should either party agree to talks aimed at solving the conflict.

item.title: Pro-Palestinian flotilla’s new Gaza mission to start on April 12
item.description: A flotilla of pro-Palestinian activists who attempted to reach Gaza last year said on Thursday they would launch a new mission to the enclave on April 12

item.title: Hamas wants Israeli troop withdrawal before disarmament talks
item.description: Hamas has told mediators it will not discuss giving up arms without guarantees that Israel will fully withdraw from Gaza as laid out in a disarmament plan

item.title: Trump sacks Bondi, appoints ex-personal attorney to head justice dept
item.description: US President Trump fired Attorney General Pam Bondi on Thursday and named his former personal lawyer to serve as the acting chief of the Justice Department

item.title: Hegseth asked US Army chief of staff to step down
item.description: Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth has asked General Randy George to step down as chief of staff of the US Army, an official said Thursday

item.title: Pakistan says onus on Afghanistan to end hostilities
item.description: Pakistan said that the burden of ending its cross-border conflict lay with Afghanistan, as the two sides held preliminary talks to try to end hostilities

item.title: Judges say ICC prosecutor in sexual misconduct inquiry can potentially resume work, documents show
item.description: Judges said the ICC chief prosecutor can resume his duties after dismissing a UN investigation into alleged sexual misconduct, according to AP

item.title: Iran vows ’crushing’ attacks as strikes hit regional infrastructure
item.description: Iran and its allies traded fire with Israel and the US, as American-linked assets across the Middle East were targeted alongside energy and civilian sites

item.title: Paris police ban French Muslim gathering, citing security risk
item.description: The Paris police on Thursday banned an annual gathering of French Muslims north of the capital, citing a "major terrorist risk" that it might be targeted

item.title: Activist Mahmoud Khalil seeks judge’s removal from appeal panel
item.description: Lawyers for Mahmoud Khalil have asked Judge Emil Bove to step aside from his appeal due to his past role at the Justice Department

item.title: UN set to vote on a watered-down proposal to open Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The UN Security Council will vote Friday on a watered-down proposal to secure the Strait of Hormuz after opposition from China and Russia
